title: The Double Contact
author: Marguerite Brightwater
blurb: Hazel Zhou, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
